description: Convert a local time in one city into one or more other cities' time zones, e.g. 3pm in Warsaw in New York and Bangalore. Use when the user names a time in one place and asks what it is elsewhere, or whether it falls in work hours there. Each city has its IANA time zone and says whether the converted time is in work hours. Each city says whether that local date is a public holiday. The result includes a https://timeofmeeting.com link for a 60-minute meeting. A different length can be set when the invitation is built. status is unique when that clock time happens once, gap when the clocks skip it, or overlap when it happens twice. wall.utc is the chosen instant. When no offset is given, that is the compatible reading: the later side of a gap and the earlier side of an overlap.

from.description: The city the clock time belongs to. City name, a city id from a city search, or an IANA time zone such as Europe/Copenhagen. Spelling and accents are flexible. When several cities share a name, the best match from the site search is used and the others come back in alternatives.

time.description: Local time in the from city, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. An offset such as 2027-10-31T02:30+02:00 selects that instant when the clock time happens twice. A time alone, such as 09:00, 9:00, or 09:00:00, is that time today in the from city.

to.description: Cities to convert into. An array, or one comma-separated string. City name, a city id from a city search, or an IANA time zone such as Europe/Copenhagen. Spelling and accents are flexible. When several cities share a name, the best match from the site search is used and the others come back in alternatives.

name: convert_time

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

weeks.description: ISO week (Monday start; week 1 contains the year's first Thursday) and US week (Sunday start; 1 January is week 1 of that calendar year).

title: Convert a local time
